comparison.objective: Remove a wooden utensil hazard before energizing a burner; candidate safely adjusts an isolated damper before cycling it.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1238 tests hazard recognition, object removal, pan placement, and knob actuation; candidate tests hex-tool use, fine adjustment, counterholding, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1238 permanently fails on energized utensil contact; detailed pan/knob thresholds are absent and no spec versions exist. Candidate adds quantitative performance cycles and damage gates.
comparison.reason: Both enforce de-energized prerequisites, but that procedural safety primitive alone does not establish task overlap.
